headline: CHC @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.62 at ATL 4.12, with a projected total of 8.74. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (CHC -0.53, ATL -0.55), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.07, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Colin Rea has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Matt Olson, Ozzie Albies, Michael Busch, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Moisés Ballesteros, Matt Shaw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
